purpose: Records the policy forge adopts for authoring Claude Code SKILLs and agents beyond the generic authoring guide, including how to verify official specs.
summary: How to verify official Claude Code specifications using meta references and the claude-code-guide Agent
All SKILLs are written as inherited type; context: fork and agent are not used
Isolated-context processing is implemented as a custom Agent launched via the Agent tool
Inherited SKILLs must state that they do only their own task and not take over parent work
New custom Agents require design rationale recorded and Role constraint tests
Questions and confirmations use AskUserQuestion, not plain text
Exception for discussion-driven SKILLs, with the boundary declared in the body
Do not block AskUserQuestion via disallowed-tools
SKILL.md descriptions are written in Japanese
tasks: Designing user confirmation flows in a SKILL
Verifying official Claude Code behavior before writing
Reviewing SKILLs for authoring policy compliance
title: Claude Code 作成方針（forge）
